title: Physical and Spiritual Balance Comes with Fasting
body:
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. I am intending to fast today to make my Lord and His most beloved
servant, the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), happy with me! Some unfortuante people never find
anything to eat or drink. Those who train by fasting may become sabrun, patient, keeping oneself for the
honor of the Lord of Heavens. That is our intention when we fast, and without an intention nothing is going
to be accepted. Our intention is to make our Lord happy with us, then He will make us happy here and
Hereafter.
We are ghanima (prosperous from battle), training our bodies through fasting and making a good physical
balance for all our organs. And we are saying, “Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. By the Name of Allah
Almighty, All Merciful, I am intending not to eat or drink and to be patient, for the honor of the Lord of
Heavens.”
We are also trying to be like angels that never eat or drink, but who only glorify their Lord, their Creator. We
intend to try and make our Lord happy with us and we are trying to be, even for some time, like angels. That
is hilye, characteristics of Sayyidina Muhammad (s): to have a diet, to achieve a balance in our physical being,
and to save our bodies from so many useless matters. We use fasting to become healthy because when we fast
our bodies save energy.

If you are fasting, our bodies are not like when we were young; we are fat now and some have become one
that it is difficult for him to move, walk, run or do many things. He is always accustomed to save what he is
eating and drinking (not burning calories), and his body changes. First we have youngsters’ bodies, but after
a while they will change into an ugly shape. The one who fasts has a balance with every organ in its original
form, but the one who is eating and drinking without thinking, his body will become ugly. Nowadays women
and men are ugly. While young one’s body is nice, but after a while it becomes like a bull that overeats and
becomes much bigger than its normal body.
Therefore, all orders of Allah Almighty have countless wisdom, but people are not taking care to follow them;
they are mostly slaves of their egoistic desires, which makes a person’s physical appearance ugly, and
spiritually they get less until they no longer desire holy things. Therefore, it is very important for people to
know such wisdom so they will always be lovely, up to the end of their lives. Do you understand?
Fatihah.
